n: Coding as Another Language (Boston College DevTech)
t: Free K-2 units that teach coding alongside literacy with ScratchJr or KIBO robots.
steps: Find the Coding as Another Language curriculum from the Boston College DevTech group.
Choose ScratchJr on tablets or KIBO robots.
Install the free ScratchJr app on tablets.
Gather materials for the unplugged games.
Read the overview for the first unit.
Try one unplugged game with a small group.
